verdict.rationale: ClickUp's API docs reference List-level Custom Fields (move_custom_fields) and custom task types. A hands-on community user specifically praises how quickly ClickUp lets you configure task statuses compared with JIRA. Together these cover both halves of the story, but only indirectly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of creating and configuring custom fields and status workflows, and evidence of the range of field types or status configuration options.
